meta.title: How it works — Mobilcab
meta.description: Three short clips: a corner cabinet designed in under 10 minutes, the AI assistant catching mistakes before cutting, and cutlist export for your CNC.

hero.label: How it works
hero.title: From the first panel to the cutting file.
hero.body: Three short clips on the same project. Under each one, a quick summary of what happens — in case you don't have time to watch right now.

videos.title: Design flow
videos.aha: A corner kitchen cabinet from scratch, in under 10 minutes.
points: Set the cabinet dimensions, place the panels, adjust the corner joint and add the doors and drawers.
Change one dimension, and the other panels adjust automatically.
All straight from the browser, nothing to install.

videos.title: AI assistant
videos.aha: Catches a clearance mistake before it hits the saw.
points: The AI notices the drawer would collide with the door hinge — before you send the project to the CNC.
It suggests a different panel split that reduces material waste.
It doesn't replace your experience, but it catches mistakes before they cost you material.
videos.note: AI suggestions are advisory: always verify dimensions before cutting.

videos.title: Cutlist & CNC export
videos.aha: From design to cutting file, no manual math.
points: From a finished design, one click on "Export cutlist".
The list appears instantly, with panel dimensions, quantities and materials.
The file is ready for your CNC workflow.
